title: notbot — Think a little differently.
excerpt: One prompt. Five chances. One very confident AI. A daily game for wonderfully unpredictable minds.
content_html:
HUMAN VS. MACHINE · DAILY EXPERIMENT

Beautifully
unpredictable.

It thinks it knows you.
Five answers. Prove it wrong.

DAILY EXPERIMENT

One daily prompt. Five chances. Zero ordinary thinking.

↓ ENTER YOUR UNEXPECTEDNO TIMER. JUST YOUR BRAIN.

DAILY CHALLENGE #001

CONNECTING TO THE CHAMBER

Skip the obvious. Follow the weird little thought.

A small daily reminder that you’re more than a pattern.

PLAYER MANUAL

A little less obvious.
A lot more you.

  1. One prompt, every day.

    Everyone gets the same category. You have five different answers and as much thinking time as you like.

  2. The AI commits first.

    JEV ranks a reviewed answer pool and seals ten predictions on the server before you play. They stay fixed for everyone that day. A valid answer outside that list is a win for you. A predicted answer gives the machine a point.

  3. Make the unexpected count.

    A surprise earns 25 points plus up to 75 rarity points. Rarity uses the share of today’s players who gave the same answer. Scores update as people play and become final at midnight UTC. The prediction list is revealed after all five answers.

THE PERFECT SURPRISE

One of a Mind.

100 pts

A valid answer the AI missed, rare enough among real players to earn the maximum. One wonderfully human thought. One very confused machine.

Familiar answers are checked instantly. JEV judges new ideas and groups equivalent answers together. Invalid or uncertain answers never use a chance. With very few players, rarity scores will naturally be modest.

 A RECORD OF YOUR UNPREDICTABILITY

Your human history.

Your progress is saved for this browser. Clearing cookies or switching devices starts a new player history. New challenges arrive at midnight UTC. Today’s points may change as more people play.

 A FRIENDLY HUMAN–MACHINE RIVALRY

You’re more than
your next prediction.

notbot is a daily ritual for your least obvious ideas. The machine has its patterns. You have that wonderfully specific thing you remembered for no reason.

Powered by JEV. Each day, JEV ranks a reviewed pool of answers and the server seals its ten predictions. Familiar answers are validated instantly; unfamiliar answers are sent to TypeSafe’s JEV service to check whether they fit and match an existing answer.

Rarity comes from real accepted answers, not AI estimates. One signed-in player counts once per answer. A surprise scores 25 + round(75 × (1 − matching players / all participating players)). Scores stay provisional until midnight UTC. Invalid answers and outages cost no chances.

We store your answers and a random browser identifier in a secure cookie to save progress and count rarity. Each browser session counts as one player; this is not a verified count of unique people. Clearing cookies or changing browsers starts a new history. JEV receives the prompt and answer, never your name or email. Google Analytics measures visits and usage. We do not send game answers or account identifiers to Google Analytics. AI judgments can be imperfect; try a clearer name if an answer is uncertain.
